name: Maria R.
text: She explained everything calmly. I left with a written plan and the peace of mind of knowing exactly what I needed and what it would cost.
quote: Calm, clear explanation and a real plan.

name: Carlos G.
text: I've lived in Asunción for three years and couldn't find a dentist who spoke English. Dra. GP understood me perfectly and gave me clear options.

name: Andrea V.
text: I was told I needed a crown and she showed me a restoration would be enough. She saved me money and preserved my tooth.

name: John D.
text: Clear communication, written plan, no pressure. Exactly what I needed after a bad experience elsewhere.

name: Laura M.
text: I came from Luque because the waiting room felt calm and professional. Here they gave me a written estimate and a timeline before starting anything.

name: Roberto S.
text: After two failed implant attempts elsewhere, she laid out a realistic plan. I finally know where I stand and what comes next.

name: Emily T.
text: I reached out from the US for a second opinion before getting implants in Paraguay. She reviewed my records, responded in English, and gave me a clear written report I could share with my local surgeon.

name: Paula N.
text: I was anxious about my cleaning because of a bad past experience. She walked me through every step and it was completely comfortable.

name: Diego F.
text: Complex case, reasonable pricing. She told me what could be saved instead of recommending extraction immediately. That’s rare.
quote: She saved what could be saved.
